propositions: Token usage extracted by the LLM runner is discarded by the review bot and never emitted to CloudWatch, leaving no billable usage visibility.
The code-review finalize step reads _usage only to count verify requests, not to capture input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens.
The finalize aggregator must sum token fields across all succeeded agent steps (verify and decide) and add them to coverage.metrics for both CloudWatch emission and artifact persistence.

The voter must publish five separate token count metrics to CloudWatch (review_bot_llm_input_tokens, review_bot_llm_output_tokens, review_bot_llm_cache_read_tokens, review_bot_llm_cache_write_tokens, review_bot_llm_total_tokens) as best-effort operations that never fail the vote.
Pass-1 finder token usage is not surfaced on step outputs and requires a separate follow-up ticket to thread through the shared plan-review path.
